name: agent-orchestration-studio
description: Coordinate AI agents in VS Code with model providers, tool approvals, task delegation, and persistent memory.

scripts.build:webview: bun build webview-ui/src/main.tsx --target=browser --format=esm --production --entry-naming [name].[ext] --asset-naming [name].[ext] --outdir dist/webview && bun scripts/build-robot-runtime.ts
scripts.package: bun run compile && bunx --bun vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm --prefix desktop/renderer-next run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && npm run compile && node desktop/start-electron.cjs --dev"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run compile && npm --prefix desktop/renderer-next run build

chatParticipants.name: orchestrator
chatParticipants.description: Coordinate specialized agents to solve a task.

agentOrchestrator.externalTools.enabled.description: Let agents use tools registered in VS Code, such as MCP servers configured with “MCP: Add Server”. Agents see only a few relevant tools at a time and can search for more with find_tools.

agentOrchestrator.externalTools.toolPatt.markdownDescription: Which registered tools count as agent tools (`*` is a wildcard). The default takes MCP server tools only. Run **Agent Orchestration Studio: Show External Tools** to see real tool names.

agentOrchestrator.externalTools.agentToo.markdownDescription: Which external tools each agent may use: agent id (or `*` for the rest) → tool name patterns. Example: `{ "devops": ["mcp_github_*", "mcp_kubernetes_*"], "researcher": ["mcp_fetch_*"], "*": [] }`.

agentOrchestrator.externalTools.autoAppr.markdownDescription: External tools that may run without asking, e.g. read-only ones like `mcp_github_get_*`. All others need approval unless the chat is in Full access mode.

agentOrchestrator.cliAgents.markdownDescription: Coding-agent CLIs that can run an agent's whole task. Assign one to an agent under **Manage agents → Agent runtime**. Presets: `claude-code` (Claude Code) and `codex` (OpenAI Codex CLI); `custom` runs `command` with `args` (`{prompt}` is replaced by the task). They use their own tools and permissions; the chat's approval mode maps to their safest matching setting (Ask → read-only/plan, Approve for me → may edit files, Full access → no safeguards).

command.description: Executable to run. Presets default to claude / codex.

args.description: Custom args; {prompt} is replaced by the task, otherwise the task is appended.

agentOrchestrator.apiKey.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

agentOrchestrator.providers.description: Named model connections. API keys are stored separately in VS Code Secret Storage using the Configure Provider API Key command.

id.description: Stable provider identifier assigned to agents.

embeddingModel.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embeddings model used for semantic memory retrieval.

agentOrchestrator.activeProviderId.description: Provider id to use when providers are configured.

agentOrchestrator.activeModel.description: Model to use on the active provider.

agentOrchestrator.n8nLinks.description: n8n agent webhook connections. Tokens are stored separately in VS Code Secret Storage using the Configure n8n Token command.

id.description: Stable connection identifier assigned to agents.

agentOrchestrator.socketLinks.description: Persistent WebSocket agent runtimes. The server must implement the Agent Orchestration Studio JSON request/response protocol documented in README.md. Tokens are stored separately in VS Code Secret Storage.

id.description: Stable connection identifier assigned to agents.

url.description: Use wss://, or ws:// for localhost.

agentOrchestrator.maxConcurrentTasks.description: Maximum root agent tasks to run concurrently.

agentOrchestrator.layaEnabled.description: Use the configured Laya SystemOne API for routing and selective tool/retrieval decisions. When no endpoint is available, the fallback mode applies.

agentOrchestrator.layaEndpoint.markdownDescription:
Laya endpoint, e.g. `https://your-laya-host/v1/systemone` (plain HTTP is allowed only for localhost).

**API key:** [Set the Laya API key](command:agentOrchestrator.configureLayaKey) — it is sent as a Bearer token and kept in VS Code Secret Storage, not in settings.json. Then [test the connection](command:agentOrchestrator.testLaya).

agentOrchestrator.layaRetryMinutes.markdownDescription: Laya is paused after 3 slow or failed requests in a row (or at once for a rejected key or bad URL), and decisions then use the fallback. While paused, one small background request is sent every this many minutes; Laya resumes when it answers. `0` = stay paused until you resume it (**Agent Orchestration Studio: Resume Laya** or click the status bar item).

agentOrchestrator.layaModel.markdownDescription: Laya model sent with each decision request, e.g. `laya-multilingual`. Leave empty for services that serve a single model.

agentOrchestrator.layaKeepAlive.markdownDescription: Optional `keep_alive` for Ollama-style Laya servers, e.g. `30m`, `2h`, or `-1`. Leave empty for Unsloth's Decision API, which rejects this field. If a server rejects it, the extension retries once without it and remembers that for later requests.

agentOrchestrator.layaTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Maximum time allowed for each Laya decision request, in milliseconds. A request that takes longer falls back for that decision only. When the model may have been unloaded (first request, after a failure, or idle past `layaKeepAlive`), the request is allowed 30 s so the model can load. [Test the connection](command:agentOrchestrator.testLaya) to see how long yours take.

agentOrchestrator.layaFallbackMode.description: Behavior when Laya is disabled, unconfigured, or unreachable. none keeps the configured lead agent and skips optional retrieval; rules uses the local deterministic fallback.

agentOrchestrator.maxAgentRunsPerRequest.markdownDescription: Most agent runs one request may start through hand-offs and teams (`ask_agent`, `delegate_task`, `delegate_team`), counting every level. Agents choose who to involve; this keeps a team from fanning out without end.

agentOrchestrator.contextRecentMessages.description: Maximum recent messages included in compact agent context.

agentOrchestrator.contextMaxTokens.description: Approximate maximum context budget for recent messages, retrieved memories and graph facts.

agentOrchestrator.vectorEnabled.description: Use the active OpenAI-compatible provider's embeddingModel for semantic memory retrieval. Lexical and knowledge-graph retrieval work when disabled.

agentOrchestrator.approvalMode.description: ask prompts before workspace writes and persistent memory changes; approve allows those workspace-scoped changes automatically; full also exposes shell commands with current-user permissions, started in the workspace directory.

agentOrchestrator.robotModel.description: 3D robot used by the chat welcome hero and the agent avatars. Every model plays the same animations. Open chat windows update as soon as this setting changes.
